title: Welcome Party
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, the office prepares a welcome party for Nellie, despite mixed feelings about her among the staff. Jim and Pam plan a prank party with bad food and a passive-aggressive card, while Nellie reveals painful memories about her ex-boyfriend Henry. Andy struggles with his romantic situation, initially coming out as gay to Jessica but later clarifying he is in love with Erin, leading to tension at the party. The episode features humorous moments including debates about Stanley's moustache, sarcastic remarks about Pam, and a magician's surprising performance, ending with unresolved tensions and open questions about relationships and party outcomes.
